name: xstate-v5
headline: Vue Pinia Best Practices
short_description: This skill provides best practices for setting up Vue Pinia state management, focusing on store initialization, reactivity issues, and effective state patterns. It's intended for Vue developers seeking to optimize their state management practices.
author: vuejs-ai

sections.overview:
vue-pinia-best-practices is an AI skill that guides Vue 3 developers through proper Pinia state management patterns. The skill addresses store initialization, common reactivity issues, and effective state management approaches that improve code quality and maintainability. It helps developers avoid anti-patterns and implement proven patterns for managing application state with Pinia. By using this skill, you receive consistent recommendations grounded in Vue 3 and Pinia best practices, reducing trial-and-error in state management architecture.
Troubleshooting state management issues in Vue applications
Implementing best practices for store setups in Pinia
Avoiding common reactivity pitfalls in Vue
Synchronizing ephemeral state like URL filters
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/vuejs-ai/skills --skill vue-pinia-best-practices`
`git clone https://github.com/vuejs-ai/skills`
